objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Recover the server's private key through the key exchange and read the flag.
hints: You name the curve of your point; the server's key lives on another one.
Small subgroups leak the key modulo small numbers: combine the pieces.

steps.title: Identify the key exchange
steps.prompt: Which key agreement sets up the secure channel? (acronym)

steps.title: Identify the encoding
steps.prompt: Which serialization format carries the protocol messages?

steps.title: Name the attack
steps.prompt: What attack sends a point that is not on the server's curve to learn its key?

steps.title: Combine the pieces
steps.prompt: Which theorem combines residues modulo small primes into the full key?
